description: This file defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes for managing iControl Rules, including triggers, constraints, actions, schedules, and the top-level rule structure. It also declares functions for parsing and destroying rules, and setting action list directories.

methods.name: icrule_set_action_list_dir
methods.description: Sets the directory where action definition XML files are located.

methods.name: icrule_parse
methods.description: Parses an iControl Rule from XML data in memory.

methods.name: icrule_parse_file
methods.description: Parses an iControl Rule from a file.

methods.name: icrule_destroy
methods.description: Releases memory allocated for an iControl Rule.
